msContents.summary: Collection of alchemical works, including four tracts by Christophorus Parisiensis; with some added receipts in Italian. The main texts written in an neat humanistic hand. 25-27 lines to a page. Ornamental initial I in red and blue on fol. 1, a few other initials in alternate red and blue: headings in red. On fol. 63 is a faint pencil drawing of a symbolic alchemical figure, and on fol. 115v a pen-drawing of a chemical flask. [li]Christophorus Parisiensis. Summa minor: in Italian. Fol. 1 (red) IN nomine sancte et indiuidue trinitatis incipit opus de trans/mutatione corporum editum per excellentissimum phylosophum ac/theologum magistrum christophorum parisiensim quod ab ipso appel/latur Summa minor artis transmulationis metalorum [sic]... line 8 FIol Carissimo adi vltimo setembrio... 21v ...di quella excelente et/gloriosa republica. ex parissio die xxiii. decembris 1470./(red) Explicit summa minor excellentissimi philosophi ac theologi ma/gistri christophori parisiensis de compositione magni/lapidis ad laudem et gloriam om/nipotentis dei et domini/nostri yhesu cristi et/gloriosissime/semper/uirginis/marie/matris/eius/amen.[/li][li]Christophorus Parisiensis. Alphabetum: in Italin. Fol. 22 A (red). Pointur esse deus. B. (red). Significat fuocho contra naturm... 22v ...de passati nostri predeces/sori lanima de i qual sia benedecto in eternum et vltra.//(ref) Deo Gratias. Amen. 23 Alchemical receipts in Italian, by an early 16th century hand. 24. Blank.[/li][li]Christophorus Parisiensis. Cithara: in Italian. Fol. 25 (red) Deus Sanctissime. Existens. Ineffabiliter Gloriosus .../.../. line 4 ...Incipit opus de compositione magni lapidis editum/per excellentissimum philosophum ac theologum magistrum christophorum parisien/sem. Quod ab ipso cithara appellatur in qua omnes philosophorum colocantur [sic] melodie artis transmutationis metallorum... line 10 [D]EO excelso et glorioso idio benigno... 39 Siamo sempre at tuti i piatori tuoi. Ex parusio [sic] die 12 Septembris MO.cccclxiiii./Deo Gratias. Amen./(red) Explicit citharam eximii doctoris magistri christophori parisiensis/de corporum transmutatione ad lauden omnipo/tentis dei et domini nostri yhesu christi/et gloriosissime semper uir/ginis marie matris/eius et sanctorum/apostolorum/petri et/pauli.[/li][li](Lullius (Raymundus). Investigatio secreti occulti: Pars III) In Latin by an early 16th century hand. Fol. 39v In nomine patris et filii eius ihesu christi et spiritus sancti/mediante homine fit lapis ut sich [sic]. Azipe [sic] urinam humanam de 12 puerorum mundorum absque barba virginum. ... 42 De quo lapide sichut [sic] dictum est de aqua fit/perfectio de sue perfeczione [sic] laudatur deus/ihesus christus benediti [sic] Amen.[/li][li]Christophorus Parisiensis. Lucidarium: in Italian. Fol. 43 (red) IN nomine dei altissimi Auctoris et reparatoris.../.../(line 3) ... Opus magni lapidis. Incipit editum/per excellentissimum philosophum ac theologum magistrum christophroum parisiensem/quod in ipso lucidarium nuncupatus artis transmutationis methalorum [sic] forma/liter et substantialiter.../.../(line 16)...DOpoi molta considera/tion lucidissimamente habiamo compresso... 84v ...et qual si pia/za dio tel mandaremo.//(red) Explicit lucidarium eximii doctoris magistri cristophori/parisiensis de corporum transmutatio/ne. Ad laudem gloriose/uirginis marie./Amen./finis.[/li][li]Christophorus Parisiensis. Alphabeto del Luzidario. Fol. 85 A. Materia prima... Z. ignis zinerum. 86 Blank.[/li][li]Arnoldus de Villanova. Rosarius major. Fol. 87 (red) Rosarius maior secundum Arnaldum de Villanoua inter/exteros nobilior et compendiosus prohemium./Liber abbreuiatus probatus... 113 ...quamuis non intelligentibus satis sit prolixum./(red) Finit liber Rosarii maioris feliciter quem ad laudem dei/pare uirginis marie tibique Jacobo aromatario amundo/perscripsi Ego. Agostinus. philosophus. ariminensis de aquilantibus. M.cccccvii die xvii Septembris. hora 3a noctis regnantibus. Ju/lio 2pontifice maximo. et Leonardo lauredano princi/pe Serenissimo venetiarum.//Venetiis.[/li][li]Christophorus Pariensis. Accurtatio: in Venetian dialect. Fol. 113 Acurtazion de domino christofalo/parisienzis la qual chomezo quissi.//Per satisfare al dexiderio nostro... 117v ...dapoi segui li altri magisterii.[/li][li]Daniel Riginus. Carmina de lapide philosophorum: in Italian verse. Fol. 118 Carmina danielis de lapide philosophorum.//El me dileeta de dire breuemente/... 122 Et me uiuere a malis liberari.//Laus deo.[/li][li](Arnoldus de Villanova ?) Recepta: in Venetian dialect. Fol. 131 AL nome de dio Amen. InCommenziamo la uera opera benedita./R/librum 1 de limatura derame monda oncto... 141v ...spesse uolte que ello ha/sette.//Finis. Ff. 142-End Receipt and process for making the Universal Medicine: in Venetian dialect.[/li]
